title: 1908 Portuguese legislative election
summary: Portugal elected the 157 deputies of the Chamber on 5 April 1908, nine weeks after the regicide and the fall of João Franco’s government, in the first ballot of what contemporaries called the acalmação — the attempt to put the constitutional forms back after a year of rule by decree. By then both parties of the rotation had split, and the result was the most divided Chamber in decades: the Regenerators returned largest with 62 seats of 157 and nothing like a majority, and the republicans returned a small group of their own. No stable government could be formed from it, and the monarchy spent its last two and a half years in ministries that lasted months each. It is in the atlas for that deadlock rather than for the result.

actors.role: king in whose name it was called
